title: The chat composer over your bro: open, closed, stood down under a decision panel
oneLine: chatBubbleBus.open with five closers and a two-way reconcile against the modal guard; the draft
topConcern: Comment promises a guard close keeps the typed draft; every close runs setVal(''), so a trade invite landing loses the half-written line.

title: Dictation mic in the chat composer (idle, listening, thinking)
oneLine: Web Speech recogniser per dictation: micState idle/listening/thinking and recRef
topConcern: Abort runs only on unmount and the composer never unmounts: closing it mid-sentence leaves the mic hot and the words land in the next draft.

title: World Chat corner: the bell vs the open feed, its unread mark and its tap-to-close classifier
oneLine: Remembered fold flag, newest-shown mark for unread, two tap recognisers, busy and guard stand-down
topConcern: Stale comments: shut is the default now, so own sent lines and everything since boot count unread; the remount premise is gone.

title: The Auction House listing chat bus (storeChatBus): additions to P1-17
oneLine: One open listing's threads and offers, loading and error, plus per-listing unread counts
topConcern: 'Opening…' has no timeout or reconnect re-ask, and setErr is not scoped to the open listing.

title: The info popup: open window, stepper count, open chip, and the Spend that stays
oneLine: One payload holder with per-window stepper and chip state, and a 3.6 s fallback for a staying Spend
topConcern: Fallback hands Spend back while the first spend may still be in flight; nothing closes the popup on zone change or death.

title: The old inspect card (InspectCard.jsx + inspectCardBus)
oneLine: Profile card state; imported but never rendered, opened only by the dead wheel and a debug command

title: The legacy Build (T2) spend screen and its 'Apply 1 point?' confirm
oneLine: Client-side legacy point spend: confirm bus, local apply, bt_rpg write, stats_update with whole tables
topConcern: Client decides the spend and ships the whole allocation for the worker to clamp; only reachable without prog3.

title: Restart character from Settings (idle, confirm, connecting, sending, offline, wipe, reload)
oneLine: Five-stage restart with a 400 ms reconnect loop, an 8 s fallback reload, and the server's snapshot-and-delete
topConcern: The 8 s fallback reload skips the cache wipe the ack path does: a lost ack after a real wipe boots over old caches.

title: The Friends page: view, row menu, open DM thread, and the optimistic DM / Block / Remove sends
oneLine: Friends, requests and blocked views; one open thread suppressing unread; fire-and-forget friend sends
topConcern: Refused or dropped DMs show as sent (friend_error never read); Block on a mutual friend leaves friendship, row and DMs in place.

title: The Pets page: one open row and its sub-step (rename, release ask, sell, Pet House ask)
oneLine: Row accordion with exclusive sub-steps; every change asked of the worker; one guarded HTTP listing await
topConcern: While List is in flight the row's other buttons stay live and its answer closes whatever row is open now; UI flicker only.

title: Feedback: the report's send and the board's up-vote toggle
oneLine: Four-state HTTP report send and a load/failed board with a per-ticket vote toggle
topConcern: Rate limit and votes key on the body's playerId with no token: rotate ids past the limit, or toggle someone else's vote off.

title: Ranks: per-category leaderboard fetch with a 20 s refresh, and the Biggest-fish board's room ask
oneLine: Per-category cached boards with an alive flag per fetch, and a 30 s fish-board ask to the room

title: Achievements page: filter chip, the opened row, and the title ask's wait (page half)
oneLine: Filter and one open row over the worker's record; a title ask waits at most 4 s

title: The Codex's monster pages: grid, page, tab, drop card, elder toggle, and the one-shot open request
oneLine: Grid, page, tab and drop-card navigation, with the NEW MONSTER card's one-shot request to open a kind
topConcern: Unkeyed Page: switching the open monster keeps the old page's tab, elder form and drop card, and does not scroll to top.

title: The Codex stage: strips loading (baked, revoked) and the beat loop
oneLine: Strip load holder baking blob URLs revoked on change, and a setTimeout beat chain with a live flag

title: The nav rail's tap decision (open, rest, sideways dashboard; unfold the band)
oneLine: Maps button, dashboard mode and orientation to a dashboardPanelBus move
topConcern: Documented toggle tapDestination is dead; re-tapping a lit destination re-opens its root instead of resting.

title: Life Skills page: the in-page skill detail and the level-up seen marks
oneLine: One-shot open of a skill's detail, and a per-browser seen-levels record written on mount
topConcern: bt_skillsSeenLv is per browser, not per character: a second or restarted character is compared with another's levels.

title: Quests pages: the journal list, one quest's page, and Track (page half)
oneLine: Read-only journal views with one write, the tracked quest

title: The chat lane chips: the UI half of G5-1
oneLine: Chips set the lane mode and whisper name held in chatChannel.js
topConcern: A mode whose lane dropped out lights no chip, shows All's hint and keeps the old lane's placeholder (adds to G5-1).

title: The read-only dashboard pages (Clan/Party, Guild, Journey, Self, Stats, Map, About, Login Key, daily line, columns)
oneLine: Mount, redraw-interval, unmount views over others' records; the Clan page switches on caps.clanparty
topConcern: Self, Stats and Map are registered but unreachable by a player (only a QA test opens Map).
